name: Runner Extras - CurrReport.Language / FormatRegion
brief: Pins that a report may set CurrReport.Language and CurrReport.FormatRegion from its own triggers.
description: Setting CurrReport.Language mid-run is ordinary AL — the Base App does it per customer in Standard Sales - Invoice. It routes through NavReport's update-language action into ReportLocalLanguageScope.UpdateLanguage, which reads the session's language and format state. Those live on stacks the skeleton session left null, so the assignment threw a bare NullReferenceException from inside BC rather than doing anything. These tests pin the assignment as executable and the value as readable back.
